scope: Mac checks, CI FalkorDB4.14.11, actual Pi4 synthetic FalkorDB4.16.6 with loopback relay and local MiniLM; no production replacement certification

cases.evidence: Exact ten-tool metadata, structured/text layers, status golden text, and protocol error separation.
Exact absent UUID lookup returns found=false/episode=null, without a model request.
Synthetic legacy episode returns original metadata and precise timestamp without embeddings.
Identical UUIDs in user_primary/general_chat stay separate; all real groups/restored records untested.
Read-only ACL policy and rejected additions tested; complete per-tool zero-I/O instrumentation pending.
Unknown-group policy and addition rejection tested; complete per-tool zero-I/O instrumentation pending.
Approved project-name pattern and invalid suffixes tested at the policy boundary.
Explicit raw clear target enforcement and durable destructive ledger tested; only synthetic mode permits valid clear.
Required group enforced by shared Key shape; missing group produces protocol error.
Default/empty/duplicate read groups and round-robin merging matched observed helper behavior; empty groups call no models.
Global bound and sorting covered on small fixture; bounded lexical DB window is not full timestamp ordering parity.

Observed MCP recipes exclude BFS. Source-function ranking and actual Pi indexed reads pass. Real Python hybrid SDK search retrieves a synthetic vector outlier that bounded Rust compatibility search misses; replacement remains no-go.
Gated worker distinguishes queue acceptance from exact committed lookup.
Concurrent same-UUID acceptance dispatches once; committed retry leaves original record intact.
Changed same-UUID input fails closed. Observed Python loads old body/metadata instead of replacing it; strict rejection is intentional.
Private WAL/FULL journal, single worker, strict prepare/completion transitions, uncertain model refusal and destructive tombstone history tested.

Actual Pi committed/dispatch-ambiguous SIGKILL, DB outage/reconnection and AOF restart tests pass; source fixtures cover prepared/destructive recovery. Disk-full/OOM/runtime-error rollback and external writers remain untested.
Invalid provider response is journaled as failed, produces no visible episode, and is not automatically replayed.
UUIDs and independent created/valid/invalid/expired RFC3339 strings roundtrip without precision loss.
Legacy attributes/labels/vecf32, existing UUID updates and relationship-first range-index reads pass on observed module41606 as well as CI4.14.11. Restored production schema breadth remains untested.

Actual MCP wrapper calls node.delete, not Graphiti.remove_episode. Synthetic store deletion retains entities/facts and dangling provenance; clear retains Saga/unknown labels. Journal pending recovery/tombstones added; production alias/schema behavior untested.

Observed exact fact reuse/shared provenance and supplied duplicate/contradiction decisions match selected Python bodies. Fuzzy/model entity resolution, summary updates, complete extraction and contradiction discovery remain unported.
Mock gpt-6-luna temperature=1/max_tokens<=4096/enable_thinking=false and observed decoder match. Preview extraction prompt and bounded retry/timeout differ; no real generation comparison.
Native Gemini 3072/count/finite/nonzero and LF-only preprocessing covered with dummy credentials. Batch limit 8 differs from observed 32; no numerical provider parity.
Missing/wrong bearer, Host, Origin, oversized input and two protocol-version initializations tested; existing OAuth relay not exercised.
No actual bridge/session/routing operation authorized or performed.
Legacy connect/status/read create no native graph/index; isolated graph indexes remain empty.
Same observed Pi image, Redis8.2.3/module41606/hash used for isolated synthetic tests; 42 pass. Original-data backup/restore, complete Python extraction pipeline and gateway are not tested.
Concrete gateway/reconnect/freeze/accounting/rollback gates documented; no routing/deployment/write freeze performed.

Pi4/aarch64/3795MiB synthetic timings, RSS, CPU, overload and restart recorded with 1CPU/512MiB DB. 1200 keyword facts and four English local-model facts do not certify production budgets or multilingual/large-corpus quality.
